computer.heading: What it does on your computer
items: It watches the clipboard while it runs and keeps only what looks like a Path of Exile 2 item.
<kbd>Ctrl + D</kbd> sends the game the <kbd>Ctrl + C</kbd> of one copy, once per press. It doesn’t modify the game nor read its memory.
It connects only to poe2scout, the trade site and GitHub. A search on the trade site runs only when you click.

items.question: Is it free?
answers: Yes, and it asks for no account. Its code is open, and each release is built in public by GitHub Actions, with the checksums of each file.

items.question: Why does Windows show an alert?
answers: It isn’t signed for now, so Windows may show a warning at the first launch. If it offers “More info”, choose it, then “Run anyway”. If it only offers OK, confirm and start the tool again.

items.question: Can my account be at risk?
answers: Exile Market looks up offers on the official trade site through an interface Grinding Gear Games doesn’t document. Their developer documentation says that working out such an interface goes against their terms of use (section 7i), and those terms allow them to close an account without notice.

Asked about tools like this one, Grinding Gear Games answers that it can’t comment on their legality, doesn’t encourage creating or using them, and can’t guarantee that a tool is allowed or will remain allowed (its forum, February 2024).
In practice, many players have used tools of this kind for years. That is an observation, not a permission: it can change at any time.

Grinding Gear Games doesn’t endorse or guarantee any third-party tool: using it is at your own risk. Exile Market is free and comes with no warranty, as its license states. To the extent the law allows, Sylent isn’t liable for what may happen to your account.

items.question: Why must the game run in windowed fullscreen?
answers: Windowed fullscreen or a window both work. In exclusive fullscreen, the game lets no application copy the item or show its price over it.

items.question: Which languages of the game are supported?
answers: A game client in English or in French: the tool reads no other language.

items.question: Does it work on macOS or on a console?
answers: No. It needs Windows or Linux, 64 bits; on Linux, the game through Proton, and X11 or XWayland.
